Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

multiGGM (development version)

Bug fixes

  • SSVS and multi-platform samplers: the spike-and-slab update of the graph similarity theta (inherited from the Matlab reference) drew its proposal with beta_prop as a scale but used it as a rate in the acceptance ratio, and had the sign of the (alpha - alpha_prop) * log(theta) term reversed for spike-to-slab moves. The platform similarity Phi had the same sign error and mixed scale and rate in its normalizing terms. The ratios are now computed from explicit gamma densities (as the G-Wishart sampler already did). Default SSVS fits are essentially unchanged (beta_prop = 1, w = 0.9); fits with smaller w, beta_prop != 1, or the multi-platform sampler will differ. beta_prop is now a rate for every sampler.
  • A partial hyper list no longer wipes out the other defaults for the G-Wishart and SSVS samplers. Unknown hyperparameter names are now an error.
  • simulate_multiggm(K = 1) returned two groups.
  • simulate_multiggm_platform() now shares one base graph across platforms (it drew an independent graph per platform); the data-generating process is documented, and the base and platform graphs are returned.
  • roc_auc() handles tied scores: the AUC no longer depends on edge order.

Changes

  • pip_edges(), pip_diff_edge(), posterior_pcor() and posterior_precision() now pool all chains by default (chain = NULL), like diff_summary() and select_diff_edges(); chain = i selects one.
  • New summary(), coef(), fitted() and plot() methods for multi-chain fits (multiggm_fit_list).
  • method = "ssvs_platform" now stops when nchains > 1 and warns that parallel is ignored, instead of silently running one chain.
  • Removed ineffective EIGEN_USE_BLAS / EIGEN_USE_LAPACKE defines from the mGHS sources (no change to results).
  • Repository and CRAN hygiene: compiled objects untracked, old demo moved to dev/, Depends: R (>= 4.0.0), BugReports, ASCII-only sources.
  • New tests for each fix, plus reproducibility tests (same seed, parallel versus serial, R versus C++ engine).

multiGGM 0.4.0

New features

  • multiggm_mcmc(method = "mghs") fits the multiple graphical horseshoe (Busatto & Stingo 2025), adapted from github.com/cbusatto/mGHS. It returns a multiggm_fit, so coef(), fitted(), posterior_pcor(), posterior_ci(), diff_prob_pcor(), plot_trace("theta") and multi-chain fitting work. It reproduces upstream’s draws exactly for the same seed (inst/mghs/VALIDATION.md). Local fixes: rejection samplers that could hang, stuck checks that missed NaN, and a cut-model indexing bug (inst/mghs/UPSTREAM.md). New options: thin, save_draws = FALSE (keep only running summaries), automatic restart of stuck chains.
  • diff_draws(), diff_summary(), bayes_fdr() and select_diff_edges() for differential edges between any two groups, pooling chains by default. select_diff_edges() controls the posterior expected FDR using P(|D| > delta) (all samplers) or P(g_k != g_m) (G-Wishart and SSVS).

Changes

  • pip_edges(), pip_diff_edge() and edge_counts() stop with an explanatory error for mGHS fits, which have no edge indicators.
  • print() no longer reads adj_save to count draws for mGHS fits.
